given: a stock record was previously filed for a SKU at a location
when: the team member retrieves that record later
then: the recorded quantity and combined inventory_code are read back exactly as filed

independence.rationale: AC1 covers that a write is durably persisted; this AC covers the separately observable read-back of the stored values, which can fail (retrieval path broken) while writes still succeed, and vice versa.

architectural_notes: E2E read-back path: the SPA requests the record from the JSON API boundary, which calls the service -> repository to load the persisted StockRecord and return the stored quantity + combined inventory_code. Read fidelity is a whole-stack guarantee (serialization at the boundary, query in the repository, real branch data), so it is exercised as a real-DB integration test independent of the write path. No business logic in the boundary; the repository owns the query and the models layer owns the entity shape.
